purpose: Public-safe projection of normalized Roadmapdev labor-market and Crew Blueprint demand-to-content traceability research. Current employer, market, opening, pay and labor-route intelligence remains canonical in Production Atlas.

responsibilityBands.title: Observer / Training
responsibilityBands.description: Supervised learner, internship, work-study, paid training or formal entry route.

responsibilityBands.title: General Execution
responsibilityBands.description: General stagehand, setup, load, strike and event-support execution under direction.

responsibilityBands.title: Department Execution
responsibilityBands.description: Defined department work in audio, lighting, video, staging, wardrobe, backline or adjacent technical roles.

responsibilityBands.title: Specialist / Advanced Technician
responsibilityBands.description: Deeper system knowledge, advanced operation, programming, QC, repair or specialist responsibility.

responsibilityBands.title: Lead / Supervisor
responsibilityBands.description: Crew lead, department lead, lead technician or operations supervision.

responsibilityBands.title: Project / Production Management
responsibilityBands.description: Cross-department planning, accountability, technical direction or project/production management.

responsibilityBands.title: Director / Multi-site Leadership
responsibilityBands.description: Director-level event technology, production or multi-site operational leadership.

channels.title: Stagehand & Event Labor Providers
channels.description: Labor companies, call-based providers and production labor employers supplying event crews.

channels.title: Independent Production / AVL / Rental
channels.description: Production companies and rental houses combining equipment, technical services, shop work and show-site labor.

channels.title: Venue-employed Production
channels.description: Arenas, theaters, convention centers and venues employing or directly managing production personnel.

channels.title: Hospitality & Convention AV
channels.description: Hotel, conference and convention AV employers with technician-to-lead and operations pathways.

channels.title: Union / Hiring Hall / Overhire
channels.description: Local collective-labor, referral, overhire and call-list mechanisms. Rules vary by jurisdiction.

channels.title: Civic / University / Institutional
channels.description: Municipal, university and institutional event-production departments and supplemental labor systems.

channels.title: Sports / Broadcast / Experiential
channels.description: Adjacent event-technology channels using camera, AV, installation, show-site and experiential production roles.

channels.title: Shop / Warehouse / QC / Logistics
channels.description: Persistent employment in inventory, prep, QC, repair, shipping, receiving, fleet and dock operations.

channels.title: Specialist / Lead / Management
channels.description: Advanced technical, department leadership, production coordination and operational management roles.

channels.title: Paid Entry / Training / Call List
channels.description: Internships, apprenticeships, paid training, work-study, overhire and evergreen entry pools.

pathways.title: General Production
pathways.summary: Build the shared habits employers repeatedly expect in stagehand, loader, setup/strike and general production-technician work.
pathways.workNote: Observed across labor providers, venues, unions/overhire, institutions, production companies and event-service employers.

pathways.title: Lighting
pathways.summary: Move from assigned lighting support toward system reasoning, control awareness, troubleshooting and leadership without confusing learning with authorization.
pathways.workNote: Recurring in production/rental, venue, hospitality AV, touring/festival, institutional and specialist employer channels.

pathways.title: Audio
pathways.summary: Connect audio support work to signal-flow reasoning, communication, networking, troubleshooting and the deeper responsibility expected of advanced technicians and leads.
pathways.coverageLabel: Strong coverage; depth still being reconciled
pathways.workNote: Recurring across AVL/rental, hospitality AV, venues, festivals, broadcast-adjacent and specialist technical employers.

pathways.title: Video / LED / AV
pathways.summary: Build from video/LED support into signal flow, network/control awareness, playback, troubleshooting and advanced system responsibility.
pathways.coverageLabel: Broad coverage; advanced breadth still being reconciled
pathways.workNote: Observed across production/rental, hospitality AV, broadcast/sports, venues, festivals and experiential-event employers.

pathways.title: Staging / Scenic
pathways.summary: Connect assigned staging and scenic support to equipment handling, documentation, coordinated movement, troubleshooting and department leadership.
pathways.workNote: Recurring across stage labor, production/rental, venue, theatrical, festival and experiential-build channels.

pathways.title: Shop / Warehouse / Logistics
pathways.summary: Treat the rental shop, warehouse, prep/QC, receiving, truck-stage and logistics side of live production as a real career lane—not just backstage support.
pathways.coverageLabel: Explicit employment demand + substantial course family
pathways.workNote: National research found persistent demand in rental shops, warehouses, logistics/fleet operations and production-company prep environments.

pathways.title: Backline / Props / Wardrobe
pathways.summary: Learn the department interfaces, handling, documentation and communication patterns behind three distinct specialty support areas.
pathways.workNote: Specialty demand varies more by production context than general stagehand work, so role and market evidence should be checked in Production Atlas.

pathways.title: Crew Lead / Supervisor
pathways.summary: The research shows advancement is less about collecting equipment facts and more about owning communication, coordination, documentation, escalation and crew outcomes.
pathways.workNote: Lead/supervisor signals recur across departments and employer channels, but title wording varies widely.

pathways.title: Production Coordination / Management
pathways.summary: Build the documentation, advance, labor-scheduling, stakeholder and project-accountability layer that appears repeatedly in production-manager and technical-direction roles.
pathways.workNote: Observed in production companies, venues, hospitality AV, institutions and multi-site event-technology organizations.

pathways.title: Rigging & Production Power Awareness
pathways.summary: Understand role interfaces, vocabulary, hazard boundaries, qualification gates and when work must stay with designated qualified personnel.

courses.label: View bounded infrastructure and specialty coverage

pathways.workNote: Employer demand does not grant permission or qualification. Training, employer rules, venue rules, credentials and designated-person authority remain external.
